ratings.notes: Racist relates to unfairness/discrimination (FairnessVice). Egalitarian relates to equality/justice (FairnessVirtue). Both have general moral valence.
Minimalist relates to self-discipline and striving for a less carnal way of living (PurityVirtue).
Stinky relates to disgust/uncleanliness (PurityVice). Fresh relates to clean/pure (PurityVirtue).
Legit implies proper/good, scrub implies bad/worthless (General Morality).
Self-improving aligns with self-discipline/striving for an elevated way (PurityVirtue). Self-destructive is generally negative (General Morality).
Traumatized implies suffering/harm (HarmVice). Flourishing implies well-being (Care). Both have general moral valence.
Macho can align with traditional gender roles and expectations, relating to respect for traditions (AuthorityVirtue).
Offended is in the dictionary as MoralityGeneral.
Enlightened relates to spirituality/elevated way of living (PurityVirtue). Both have general moral valence.
Masochistic involves seeking pain/harm (HarmVice). It also goes against self-discipline/treating the body as a temple (PurityVice). Both have general moral valence.
